commentary.text: 90+6' That's all for today as the game is over.

49' Matteo Politano (Napoli) wastes a promising chance! He tries his luck with a shot from mid-range, but his effort hits the left post! A few inches to the right and it could have been a sweet goal! The ball is off of the pitch and it's a goal kick for Salernitana.
48' Dangerous play by Mateusz Legowski (Salernitana). Antonio Rapuano blows his whistle for a foul.
47' The resulting set piece from Napoli is comfortably intercepted by one of the defending players.

47' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) is the one to unleash a good effort towards the right post. His shot, however, is saved by the goalkeeper. What a save! The ball goes out of play. Napoli are awarded a corner kick.
46' The second half gets underway.

42' Napoli earn a corner.
41' A first-time shot by Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) inside the box is unwittingly blocked by one of his own players. The ball is out of play. Napoli win a corner kick.
40' Corner kick. Napoli will have an opportunity.
40' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) tries to slide the ball through to a teammate but it's well blocked by a defender. Napoli have been awarded a corner kick.
37' Mateusz Legowski (Salernitana) hits a first-time shot from the edge of the box low towards the middle of the goal, but Alex Meret is equal to the task and makes a comfortable save.
37' The keeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Mateusz Legowski (Salernitana) sacrificed accuracy for power, and thus his attempt went well wide of the right post.
36' Stanislav Lobotka (Napoli) makes a reckless foul in order to win the ball from his opponent. Antonio Rapuano has a clear sight of it and blows his whistle.
33' Napoli seem to be finding their feet as they enjoy some possession. They are waiting for the right moment to create new attacking opportunities.
28' The ball is out of play. Salernitana will have a chance to score from a corner.
28' Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) fails to find any of his teammates inside the box as his pass is blocked. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Salernitana.
23' A fantastic block by a defender means that the corner from Salernitana comes to nothing.
23' Giovanni Di Lorenzo (Napoli) was all set to receive a beautiful pass into a promising position. However, one of the defenders makes a timely clearance. Napoli get a corner.
21' The ball possession at the moment is 31:69.
19' The Napoli players keep the ball and are exchanging a combination of passes. They are waiting for gaps in the defence to open up.
18' The game is interrupted. Mathias Olivera (Napoli) has violated the rules in the battle for the ball. No protests or gestures are being made as he is quite aware of what he did.
16' The corner is swung in but Napoli can’t take advantage as a defender sweeps the ball away.

15' Matteo Politano (Napoli) places a shot from the edge of the box towards the top of the net, but Guillermo Ochoa makes a terrific save to deny him. Nice play all round! The linesman points to the corner flag, Napoli are going to take it.
13' 0 - 1 Goal! Stanislav Lobotka plays a simple square pass into the feet of Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) in the box, who composes himself and lashes the ball inside the left post. 0:1.
12' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) shoots from outside the box, but his effort is blocked.
9' Antonio Rapuano couldn't ignore the rough tackle by Leo Ostigard (Napoli) and blew his whistle.
8' Salernitana force a corner. They send men into the box.
7' Salernitana have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender. Salernitana will have a chance to score from a corner kick.

7' Loum Tchaouna (Salernitana) attempts to find his teammate with a pass from outside the box, but the opposition's defence is quick to react and thwarts the attack. It will be a corner kick for Salernitana.

6' Giacomo Raspadori (Napoli) receives a precise pass in the box and takes the shot early. The ball heads low towards the middle of the goal, but Guillermo Ochoa shows off his skills and makes a brilliant save to deny him.
5' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) dribbles into space and finds himself in a shooting position, but his shot from the edge of the box is bravely blocked.

4' Khvicha Kvaratskhelia (Napoli) gets the ball from a rebound and shoots from long range, but sends the ball miles wide of the right post. The goalkeeper doesn't have to worry about this one. Very poor attempt.
3' Piotr Zielinski (Napoli) is heading toward the corner flag to take the set piece.
2' Chukwubuikem Ikwuemesi (Salernitana) sees the run of Boulaye Dia and tries to slip the ball to him, but Alex Meret sees the danger and gathers.
